description: Pre-registered transaction-cost SENSITIVITY grid for the one-shot holdout test (docs/prereg/DECISIONS.md 2026-10-16, Efe karari; docs/prereg/TRIAL_LOG.md P-03). Descriptive only: it never enters the Holm decision, the hypothesis verdict or the primary report. Nothing here changes a frozen spec, threshold or the test plan.
cost_basis: per_side (round_trip = 2 x cost_bps_per_side); net = gross - 2 * bps / 10000, same engine formula as the primary analysis
rules: Same frozen specs, same data, same test window, same seeds and horizons as the primary run; only --cost-bps differs.
The primary cost (10 bps per side) is the primary analysis and is not part of this grid.
Results are written to separate artifacts and are never passed to scripts/evaluate_study_family.py.
No sensitivity statistic changes a Holm decision, a hypothesis outcome or the primary report.
